Find first reliable matchday for a metric

Source: R/features.R
first_reliable_matchday.Rd

Returns the earliest match number where the metric achieves the reliability threshold.

Usage

first_reliable_matchday(reliability_df)

Arguments

reliability_df

A tibble from reliability_threshold().

Value

Integer. First reliable matchday, or NA if never reliable.
